experiment.claim: Issue #4 -- characterizes sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68 (small unit) and sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40 (large unit) VEB vs collector current (100nA..100uA, half-decade steps) and vs temperature/process corner, plus the PTAT dVBE between the two emitter sizes at matched current. Informs the usable current-density window / effective ideality factor for spec/topology-survey.md and the amplifier offset budget (#9). Supply axis intentionally fixed at nominal 3.30V: both devices are diode-connected (base=collector=0) and biased by ideal DC current sources with no supply-referenced terminal in the DUT, so sweeping supply would not change any result -- see design/device-characterization-summary.md. Issue #35: the EMITTER is the driven terminal (the connection a bandgap core has); the original record 20260731-043353-a8c4147 drove the collector by mistake and is superseded. The veb_* sanity window is [0.30, 1.10] V: the upper bound admits the legitimate -40C/100uA point (~1.00V, still well under the ~1.2V 0-K VEB extrapolation), and the lower bound is set below the emitter-driven 125C floor (0.403V) but ABOVE the collector-driven 125C values (0.22-0.26V), so a recurrence of the pin-order mis-wire fails the harness at the hot corners instead of passing silently.
